name: 1 Chronicles
lede: The thirteenth book of the Bible, in full: the generations from Adam, David king over all Israel, the ark brought up with singing, the covenant of an everlasting throne, and the house of Jehovah made ready for Solomon, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: From Adam
books.blurb: Adam, Seth, Enosh — the generations from the first man to Noah and his three sons; the nations of Japheth, Ham and Shem; Abraham, Isaac and Ishmael; Esau and the kings that reigned in Edom before any king reigned over Israel; the sons of Israel; and the house of Judah down to Jesse and David, the seventh son.

books.name: The Sons of David
books.blurb: The sons born to David in Hebron and in Jerusalem; the kings of Judah from Solomon to Josiah, son after son; Jeconiah the captive and Zerubbabel; the families of Judah, and Jabez, more honorable than his brethren — oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border; the potters who dwelt with the king; and Simeon at the fat pasture of Gedor.

books.name: The Sons of Levi
books.blurb: Reuben, whose birthright was given to the sons of Joseph; Gad in Bashan; the war with the Hagrites, for they cried to God in the battle; the two tribes and a half carried away beyond the river; then the sons of Levi: the high priests from Aaron to Jehozadak, the singers David set over the service of song, and the cities of the Levites.

books.name: They That Dwelt in Jerusalem
books.blurb: Issachar, Benjamin, Naphtali and Manasseh; Ephraim mourning many days, and Sheerah who built Beth-horon; the line from Ephraim to Joshua; Asher; Benjamin and the house of Saul; then all Israel reckoned by genealogies, and those who dwelt in Jerusalem: priests, Levites, and the porters on the four sides of the house, opening it morning by morning.

books.name: David King over Israel
books.blurb: Saul and his sons fallen on mount Gilboa, and the valiant men of Jabesh who buried their bones under the oak; then all Israel at Hebron — behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh; the stronghold of Zion; the mighty men, and the water of the well of Beth-lehem poured out unto Jehovah; thine are we, David; and three days of feasting, for there was joy in Israel.

books.name: The Ark of God
books.blurb: Let us bring again the ark of our God: the new cart, Uzza at the threshing-floor of Chidon, and three months in the house of Obed-edom; Hiram's cedars and the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees; then the Levites bear the ark on their shoulders, the singers sound aloud, David dances, and Asaph sings — O give thanks unto Jehovah, for his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

books.name: Thy Throne for Ever
books.blurb: Lo, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark dwelleth under curtains; the word of God to Nathan by night — I will build thee a house, and I will establish his throne for ever; who am I, O Jehovah God?; David's wars and the shields of gold; Hanun and the messengers shamed; Joab before and behind; Rabbah and the crown of gold; and the sons of the giant in Gath.
